description: This file defines a C# interface 'IBasketQueryService' within the 'Microsoft.eShopWeb.ApplicationCore.Interfaces' namespace. The interface provides a method to asynchronously retrieve the total number of basket items for a given user without loading data into memory.

classes.name: IBasketQueryService
classes.description: An interface for querying basket item counts for users asynchronously.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Asynchronously returns the total number of items in the basket for a specified user.
